# forgejo_oauth2_auth_source (Resource)

Forgejo administrator-managed OAuth2 login source. Requires an administrator token and Forgejo's auth-source API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "forgejo_oauth2_auth_source" "example" {
  name                              = "Company SSO"
  oauth2_provider                   = "openidConnect"
  client_id                         = "forgejo"
  client_secret_wo                  = var.oauth2_client_secret
  client_secret_wo_version          = 1
  openid_connect_auto_discovery_url = "https://sso.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration"
  scopes                            = ["openid", "profile", "email"]
  is_active                         = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) OAuth2 client identifier.
- `name` (String) Login source name.
- `oauth2_provider` (String) Forgejo OAuth2 provider name, such as openidConnect.

### Optional

- `admin_group` (String) Administrator group.
- `allow_username_change` (Boolean) Allow users to change their username.
- `attribute_ssh_public_key` (String) OAuth2 attribute containing SSH public keys.
- `client_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive) Write-only OAuth2 client secret. Required when creating a source; omit when importing. Set client_secret_wo_version to rotate it later.
- `client_secret_wo_version` (Number) Change this revision to replace the client secret. Omit on import to preserve the existing secret.
- `custom_url_mapping` (Attributes) Custom OAuth2 provider endpoints. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_url_mapping))
- `dyn_group_maps` (String) Dynamic group maps.
- `dyn_group_maps_removal` (Boolean) Remove memberships absent from dynamic group maps.
- `group_claim_name` (String) Group claim name.
- `group_team_map` (String) Group-to-team mapping.
- `group_team_map_removal` (Boolean) Remove team memberships absent from group mapping.
- `icon_url` (String) Sign-in icon URL.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether this source is available for sign-in.
- `openid_connect_auto_discovery_url` (String) OpenID Connect discovery URL.
- `quota_group_claim_name` (String) Quota group claim name.
- `quota_group_map` (String) Quota group map.
- `quota_group_map_removal` (Boolean) Remove quota group assignments absent from mapping.
- `required_claim_name` (String) Required claim name.
- `required_claim_value` (String) Required claim value.
- `restricted_group` (String) Restricted user group.
- `scopes` (List of String) OAuth2 scopes in request order.
- `skip_local_two_fa` (Boolean) Skip Forgejo's local two-factor check.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric source identifier, also used for import.

<a id="nestedatt--custom_url_mapping"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_url_mapping`

Optional:

- `auth_url` (String) Authorization endpoint.
- `email_url` (String) Email endpoint.
- `profile_url` (String) Profile endpoint.
- `tenant` (String) Provider tenant.
- `token_url` (String) Token endpoint.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import using the numeric login source ID. Omit the secret revision in the
# matching resource configuration to leave the existing secret unchanged.
terraform import forgejo_oauth2_auth_source.example 42
```
